title: Workbench with cardboard box, wooden rod, linear rail and actuator assembly
objects_and_counts: One open cardboard box is visible resting on the left portion of the assembly (box is partially cropped at the top left).
One long wooden rod or dowel lies across the top of the assembly, spanning from left to right across the scene.
At least two blue block-shaped components are mounted on a small carriage or fixture on the horizontal rail (the blocks are adjacent and partly obscured by other parts).
At least two small yellow clamp-like or spacer components are visible near the blue blocks on the same carriage.
One horizontal aluminium extrusion style rail (golden/bronze colored profile) runs across the lower centre of the image and supports the mounted carriage.
One vertical black assembly (appearing as an actuator or motor housing) stands at the right side of the image and is attached to the rail structure; it is mostly visible and not fully cropped.
Several wires and cables (multiple, uncounted) run along and under the rail and connect to components on the carriage and to the vertical assembly.
One white rectangular adhesive label is visible on the side of the cardboard box (text on the label is not readable from the image).
Additional small mechanical components and fasteners (nuts, bolts, brackets) are visible around the carriage and rail but are not individually counted.
spatial_relations: The cardboard box sits on the left side of the assembly, positioned above and slightly behind the horizontal rail and carriage.
The wooden rod lies across the scene, roughly spanning from left (over the cardboard box area) toward the right and passing over the carriage and rail.
The carriage with the blue blocks and yellow clamp-like parts is mounted on the horizontal rail near the center-left of the image; the carriage is below and slightly forward of the wooden rod.
The vertical black actuator/motor assembly is located to the right of the carriage and is attached to or adjacent to the right end of the horizontal rail.
Wires and cables run beneath and along the horizontal rail and connect between the carriage area and the vertical black assembly, forming a network under and alongside the rail.
colours_and_materials: The cardboard box is brown cardboard with a white label area and some white/blue printed panels on its side.
The rod appears to be light-coloured wood or a wood-like material.
The horizontal rail/extrusion has a gold/bronze metallic appearance (possibly anodized aluminium).
The carriage contains blue plastic or painted components and small yellow plastic or painted clamp-like pieces.
The vertical actuator/housing is black and appears to be metal or painted metal/plastic.
The floor visible beneath the assembly is green, likely painted or covered with a green material.
uncertainties: No room name or number is legible in the image; location cannot be determined from this photo alone.
Text on the white label on the cardboard box and any small nameplates or stickers on the equipment are present but not readable at the image resolution.

Blue and yellow parts are partly obscured; the count for those components is given as a minimum ("at least") because some items are cropped or overlapped and a definitive exact count cannot be determined.
